study.orden_kaissar: Position in the selected review frame.
study.autores: Author string as recorded during extraction, not the authoritative full citation.
study.year: Year as recorded for that source version.
study.title: Article title.
study.inclusion: incluir = included; excluir = excluded; pendiente = unresolved eligibility.
study.razon: Reason for eligibility disposition, independent of result sign and matrix availability.
study.acceso: Access state as recorded; consult the English registry for normalized labels.
study.fuentes: Local filenames of consulted source versions, retained as provenance only; not portable dependencies.
study.afirmacion_autores: Original authors’ claim as extracted; separate from our reference levels.
study.objetivo_fpr_numerico_autores: Whether an explicit numerical FPR target was found in the consulted source portions.
study.comparacion_qc: Recoverable quantum–classical comparison and its limits.
study.familia_informe: Documentary-family key linking related reports; not proof of experimental independence.
study.calibracion_fpr_sustentada: Whether supported FPR calibration was established from the consulted evidence.
study.registro_piloto: Link to an original pilot record where applicable; no separate study added.
study.puntos: Record IDs assigned to this article, including summary and administrative/configuration rows.
study.hashes_fuentes: SHA-256 fingerprints of privately consulted source versions.

point.id: Stable record identifier, e.g. K17-P009; not an independent-study count.
point.study: Article/frame identifier joining BASE_ESTUDIOS and SOURCE_REGISTRY.
point.dataset: Dataset name as recorded from the source; identity/version is not independently authenticated.
point.operating_point: Source-specific setting or source-object identity, not necessarily a disclosed numerical threshold.
point.fuente_localizacion: Figure, table, section or page identifying the source object.
point.tipo: Evidence representation category; see category definitions below.
point.unidad: Unit described by the source (e.g. traffic records or nodes), not automatically alerts/incidents.
point.principal: Membership in the 24-point descriptive figure; does not imply valid sampling inference.
point.n0: Benign denominator when identified or explicitly reconstruction-conditioned.
point.n1: Attack denominator when identified or explicitly reconstruction-conditioned.
point.fp: Benign cases predicted attack (any attack class).
point.tp: Attack cases predicted attack; absent when not fully allocated. Do not fill from a nominal total.
point.fpr: FP/n0, or the identified normalized benign-row error rate; stored as a proportion.
point.tpr: Identified or explicitly conditioned aggregate attack detection, stored as a proportion.
point.conteos_originales: Whether the source supplies count-based evidence; not an independence flag.
point.denominador_verificado: Extraction-level denominator flag; does not certify independent observations or selection.
point.calibracion_sustentada: Whether calibration support was established in the consulted material; false is not proof no such method exists elsewhere.
point.inferencia: Original extraction note on inferential interpretation; current display tier is added during analysis.
point.accuracy: Reported accuracy, stored as a proportion when represented in this field; cannot identify all confusion cells.
point.f1: Reported F1, stored as a proportion; class/scope follows source notes.
point.n_test_total: Reported total evaluation size or nominal source total; not automatically a benign denominator.
point.n0_upper: Upper bound on possible benign sample size from a total; not an observed benign count.
point.alternate_fpr: Alternative conditional FPR under a different class mapping/orientation; not a second observation.
point.alternate_tpr: Alternative conditional TPR under a different class mapping/orientation.
point.tpr_by_attack: Detection proportions for individual attack classes; unknown weights prevent automatic pooling.
point.tpr_range: Identified TPR range over unspecified attack-class weights, prior to extra rounding allowance.
point.rounding_step: Displayed normalized-matrix increment in proportion units; no sampling uncertainty implied.
point.tpr_identificacion: Conditions required to reconstruct the attack-detection rate.
point.nominal_size: Source nominal sample size; not necessarily the evaluated matrix total.
point.raw_matrix: Source matrix retaining its recorded class ordering.
point.raw_matrix_order: Actual/predicted axes and class-order description for raw_matrix.
point.label_mapping: Class-to-benign/attack mapping assumption or source statement.
point.positive_class: Source convention for the positive class; do not assume it means attack.
point.original_metrics: Metrics preserved in their original source representation. Units may differ (percent/proportion); consult the source before conversion.
point.f1_by_class: Source class-specific F1 scores stored as proportions; not a confusion matrix.
point.pos_val_error: Positive-class validation error as extracted; interpretation depends on class semantics.
point.neg_val_error: Negative-class validation error as extracted; interpretation depends on class semantics.
point.convergence_epochs: Reported convergence-epoch summaries by optimizer; not evaluated-case counts.

derived.resolution_fpr: Empirical count increment 1/n0; not a confidence limit.
derived.fpr_U95_cond: One-sided 95% Clopper–Pearson upper FPR limit under the specified fixed-detector binomial model.
derived.fpr_ci95_cond: Two-sided marginal 95% Clopper–Pearson FPR interval; not simultaneous coverage.
derived.tpr_ci95_cond: Two-sided marginal 95% TPR interval under the same sampling assumptions and any reconstruction conditions.
derived.reference_support_cond: Comparison of the conditional upper limit with analytical reference levels; not demonstrated population control.
derived.source_training_results: Source describes the result as training, including K11 and K17 Train objects.
derived.source_test_adjustments: Source reports adjustments after observing the test, as for K03.
derived.main_interval_display: Selects exactly six K10/K17 conditional illustrations; independence remains unverified.
derived.provenance_class: Analysis-level provenance category, kept separate from source representation tipo.
derived.provenance_en: English explanation of source provenance and interpretation.
derived.interval_status_en: Whether limits are hypothetical, conditional or unavailable; explicit interpretive status.
derived.fpr_rounding_range: FPR range assuming rounding to nearest at the displayed precision; not a confidence interval.
derived.tpr_identification_rounding_range: TPR range incorporating unknown attack weights and the stated rounding assumption.

source_registry.title: Source article title.
source_registry.authors_as_recorded: Historical author string; complete citation is in REFERENCES.tex.
source_registry.year_as_recorded: Year associated with the consulted record.
source_registry.location_and_version: Exact methodological location and source version.
source_registry.consulted_source_fingerprints: Filenames and SHA-256 of consulted copies; not file requirements.
source_registry.source_copies_in_reproduction_package: False: original report copies are intentionally excluded.
source_registry.source_access_note: How to locate the original source and interpret its fingerprint.
